title: LOGICAL: Local Obfuscation by GLINER for Impartial Context-Aware Lineage – Development and evaluation of PII Removal system.
reasoning: The paper describes a system for removing Personally Identifiable Information (PII) from clinical text. While it identifies 'religion' as a category of PII to be removed to mitigate bias and includes an institutional ethics approval statement, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, theology, morals, or ethics as a core research component.
